title: Converting gym exports with AI-generated scripts and reusable functions
description: We built a migration workflow that maps each export to MAAT fields. AI prepares the conversion script. Reusable functions process the rows, with mappings and exceptions available for review.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Giving AI a shared source of MAAT knowledge and procedures
description: We organized service guides, support procedures, and past investigations into linked files. The team and AI can follow the same path to the context a task needs.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Running support changes through reviewed MAAT Brain playbooks
description: We added executable playbooks for defined support changes. The assistant prepares the scope, the team approves it, and reviewed code runs the operation with explicit inputs.
author: Bernat Sampera

title: Answering gym owners with backend data, tables, and charts
description: I lead the Admin Agent project and its AI infrastructure and backend work. Owners ask questions in the dashboard. The agent reads their gym data and shows the answer in a useful format.
author: Bernat Sampera
